Job Title: DevOps Engineer
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Type: Permanent
 Our client are a Physical AI company looking for Engineers to work on-site in Bucharest.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design and manage CI/CD pipelines and release infrastructure for embedded, firmware, and application software.
 Develop automated test frameworks across unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) levels.
 Provision and maintain cloud and on-premise infrastructure (AWS) and containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes).
 Administer version control workflows (Git/GitLab) and track quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
 Support factory test automation and champion release readiness and QA best practices across teams.
 Requirements:
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 5+ years of experience in QA automation, DevOps, or software infrastructure.
 Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash.
 Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions) and version control workflows (Git).
 Proficiency with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and test automation frameworks.
 Desirables:
 Experience with embedded/firmware test automation and HIL environments.
 Infrastructure-as-Code expertise (Terraform, Ansible).
 Familiarity with RTOS/Linux embedded build systems and observability tooling.
 Background in robotics or safety-critical software.
 If this sounds of interest, please reach out to daniel@microtech-global.com for more information
